"""Continue an already admitted read-only observer; only reviewed Fleet metadata effects."""
import importlib.util,pathlib,time,json
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/adopt2121-20261008')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('refresh',ROOT/'refresh-fleet-snapshots.py');refresh=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(refresh)
c=refresh.c
from git_document_store import GitDocumentStore
from git_remote_identity import remote_identity
import fleet_supervisor_control as fleet

def main():
    refresh.verify_quality()
    c.verify_reviews('fleet','4e1a389a8d5fa6812c87431be9b9cb8f6f55bad9')
    root=ROOT/'fleet-snapshot-adapter';req=c.read(root/'start-request.json');h=c.read(root/'start-receipt.json')
    session,runtime,store=c.bridge._recover_session(req['handle_root'],h['handle_id'])
    assert req['plan']['tasks'][0]['role']=='read_only' and req['plan']['tasks'][0]['write_paths']==[]
    obs=runtime.observe(req['task_id'],req['attempt_id']);assert obs['status']=='awaiting_release' and obs['pending_terminal_status']=='succeeded'
    c.bridge._renew_for_result(session,store,obs,action='observe');c.bridge._read_only_result(session,runtime)
    canonical=GitDocumentStore(req['repo_root'],'origin','refs/heads/cdc/fleet-supervisor',remote_identity(req['repo_root'],'origin'))
    admission=c.read(root/'leader-admission-receipt.json');generation=admission['generation'];revision,state=canonical.read()
    owner,invocation=h['owner_id'],h['invocation_id']
    assert state['lease']['owner_id']==owner and state['lease']['generation']==generation
    assert state['lease']['invocation']['invocation_id']==invocation and state['lease']['external_guard'] is None
    assert state['lease']['finalization']['state']=='active' and all(e['state']=='terminal' for e in state['effects'])
    # Never create another leader or reconstruct a serialized terminal capability.
    activity=c.read(root/'review-packet-publication.json')
    assert c.git(req['repo_root'],'ls-remote','origin',activity['ref']).split()[0]==activity['commit']
    state['lease']=c.lease.renew(state['lease'],owner,generation,invocation,c.now(),activity_ref='git:'+activity['commit']+':document.json#accepted-targeted-quality-and-validated-readonly-result')
    fleet.validate(state);canonical.compare_and_swap(revision,state)
    source_publication=c.read(ROOT/'fleet-publication-adapter/native-publication-receipt.json')
    checkpoint=refresh.refresh(session,runtime,store,canonical,owner,generation,invocation,source_publication)
    fr,state=canonical.read();fleet.begin_finalization_cas(canonical,fr,owner,generation,invocation,c.now(),pending_shared_writes=False)
    fr,state=canonical.read();fleet.record_checkpoint_cas(canonical,fr,owner,generation,invocation,c.now(),checkpoint_ref=checkpoint)
    fr,state=canonical.read();fleet.reconcile_finalization_cas(canonical,fr,owner,generation,invocation,c.now(),external_reconciliation='none')
    session['worker_status']='succeeded'
    c.bridge._save_session(session)
    continuity=c.bridge._continuity(session,session['plan']['base_sha'],checkpoint,None,released=False)
    continuity['invocation_id']=invocation;continuity['terminal_state']['invocation_id']=invocation
    fr,state=canonical.read();fleet.mark_ready_cas(canonical,fr,owner,generation,invocation,c.now(),continuity_state=continuity)
    fr,state=canonical.read();released=fleet.release_leader_cas(canonical,fr,owner,generation,invocation,c.now());c.save(root/'canonical-leader-release.json',released)
    task=req['plan']['tasks'][0]
    finish=c.bridge.finish({'schema':'managed-host-finish/v1','handle_root':req['handle_root'],'handle_id':h['handle_id'],
                           'output_refs':task['expected_outputs'],'evidence_refs':task['expected_evidence'],'checkpoint_ref':checkpoint})
    c.save(root/'finish-receipt.json',finish);assert finish['scope_complete'] and finish['state']=='released'
    observed=runtime.observe(req['task_id'],req['attempt_id']);c.save(root/'supervisor-terminal.json',observed);assert observed['quiescent']
    fr,state=canonical.read();assert state['lease']['owner_id'] is None and state['lease']['external_guard'] is None
    print(json.dumps({'canonical_release':fr,'managed_finish':finish,'full_convergence_checkpoint':checkpoint}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Read authenticated Git facts; no publication, scheduler or product effects."""
import datetime
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import tempfile

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/adopt2121-20261008')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('common', ROOT / 'publish-consumer-live.py')
common = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(common)
from contracts import load_yaml
from consumer_lock import validate as validate_lock
from validate_adapter import validate_adapter
from validate_checkpoint_24 import validate_checkpoint_24
from convergence_vector import normalize
from fleet_supervisor import validate_snapshot
from progress_slo import validate_observation
from git_lease_store import GitLeaseStore


def facts(name, watchdog):
    request = common.read(ROOT / (name + '-adapter/start-request.json'))
    prep = common.read(ROOT / (name + '-adapter/preparation.json'))
    repo, ref = request['repo_root'], request['lease_source_ref']
    head = common.git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', ref).split()[0]
    assert head == prep['candidate'], 'Source changed; replan, never overwrite'
    common.git(repo, 'fetch', '--no-tags', 'origin', ref)
    package = common.git(repo, 'rev-parse', head + ':.agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle')
    assert package == '9c45d98c3254e9658d452c505d8c97698e3fc9a7'
    count = len(common.git(repo, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', package).splitlines())
    assert count == 352
    lock = json.loads(common.git(repo, 'show', head + ':docs/cdc-consumer-lock.json'))
    validate_lock(lock)
    assert lock['release_commit'] == '9b38bd4d9f5fb113ec10bdbca9fbe33908619a54'
    assert lock['version'] == '2.12.1' and lock['package_tree'] == package
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT) as directory:
        p = pathlib.Path(directory)
        for path, filename in [('docs/development-cycle.yaml', 'adapter.yaml'), ('docs/work-status/current.md', 'checkpoint.md')]:
            (p / filename).write_text(common.git(repo, 'show', head + ':' + path) + '\n')
        adapter = load_yaml(p / 'adapter.yaml')
        checkpoint = load_yaml(p / 'checkpoint.md', frontmatter=True)
        binding = validate_adapter(adapter, '2.12.1')
        validate_checkpoint_24(checkpoint, adapter)
    store = GitLeaseStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/coordination')
    revision, lease = store.read()
    assert lease['owner_id'] is None and lease['external_guard'] is None and lease['finalization'] is None
    assert lease['last_release']['completion_reason'] == 'scope_complete'
    now = common.now()
    observed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(watchdog['observed_at_utc'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    assert 0 <= (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - observed).total_seconds() <= 300
    assert watchdog['repository'] == request['lease_repository'] and watchdog['source_ref'] == ref
    assert watchdog['is_enabled'] is False and watchdog['source'] == 'actual automations.peek receipt'
    progress = {'schema': 'progress-observation/v1', 'observed_at_utc': now,
                'last_meaningful_progress_at_utc': None,
                'last_activity_at_utc': checkpoint['observed_at_utc'],
                'primitive_steps_since_progress': checkpoint['execution_continuity']['primitive_steps_since_progress'],
